功能开发.reason: Existing time-series inputs, source merging and temporal reducers expose domain-specific extension boundaries.

功能优化.reason: Atomic ingestion, grouped windows, counter rates and maintenance are complete usable flows with meaningful behavior evolution.

代码重构.reason: The engine owns source iteration and transaction coordination; representation boundaries can change while preserving persisted sample semantics.

依赖升级与迁移.reason: Actual format-1 JSON gzip blocks and bbolt storage provide concrete source representations; Go binary encoding and SQLite are explicit migration targets.

质量保障.reason: Public API, recorded measurements and image restore permit independent numerical and stateful verification.

项目维护.reason: Retention, deletion, read-only transitions, images and format version require state-dependent database maintenance procedures.

技术讨论.reason: Physical block layout, temporal query semantics and transaction costs support repository-specific technical decisions.

问题排查与诊断.reason: examples/session.json contains genuine observable stale materializations, negative windows, physical/logical differences and admission rejections to explain.

部署运维.reason: A runnable service, file locking, graceful shutdown and verified image reopening support isolated operational drills.

泛Agent需求.reason: Original measurements and recorded requests, block inventories, retention floors and backup receipts can be joined by series identity, time and sequence.

Bugfix.reason: The healthy baseline supports isolated Bugfix tasks against its existing database contracts. No defect is present in this baseline.

extension_seams.distinct_outcome: Timestamp corrections resolve by commit sequence
Visible points resolve physical duplicates and selectors
Group windows preserve observation weighting and half-open bounds
Counter changes are resolved per series before grouping
Physical changes preserve sample sequence and logical values
Later corrections are not hidden by older deletion sequences
Stored aggregate is paired with its namespace source sequence
Restored image represents the advertised committed database state
Presence differs in identity while absent values compare as empty
Read-only state changes admission without destroying readable data
Physical work and logical result cardinality remain distinguishable
Failure codes and bounded input prevent partial publication
Signed temporal keys and storage commits agree across restart

tension_points.description: Missing labels compare as empty but remain distinct identities

tension_points.description: Group membership and observation weighting jointly determine window values

tension_points.description: Per-series resets must be resolved before summing rates across a group

tension_points.description: Checksummed payload and head removal must publish atomically

tension_points.description: Deletion stores matched series at commit rather than changing future series
